decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed alterations to the existing house shall be begun within 3 months of the date of this permission and completed within 6 months of the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - Materials and dimensions of the proposed coping stones to be used on the gable end at scale 1:20 shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the LPA prior to the commencement of works.

Condition : 4 - Sample panels of brickwork showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing shall be provided on site and approved by the LPA before the works are commenced and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the work is completed and has been approved.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until the construction details of the roof and dormers hereby permitted have been agreed to and approved in writing by the PLA. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 6 - There shall be no parapet or coping stone dividing the roof between numbers 32 and 34 to the front and rear.
